articles.title: Comic-Con Sneak Peek: Percy Jackson Season 3 Opens with a Clash Between Demigods
articles.summary: At San Diego Comic-Con, Disney+ debuted the opening scene of Percy Jackson Season 3, adapting "The Titan's Curse." The footage shows Thalia battling a monster solo before Percy intervenes, sparking tension. Walker Scobell promises the most book-accurate season yet, with new cast members like Kate McKinnon joining the mythological adventure.

articles.title: From the Diving Board to the Big Screen: Jason Statham Revisits His Athletic Roots in Moscow
articles.summary: Jason Statham, known for action blockbusters, made a surprise appearance at a high diving event in Moscow, donning a competition suit and training alongside athletes. Before Hollywood, Statham was a British national diver who competed at the 1990 Commonwealth Games. He calls missing the Olympics a "sore point," but his return to the pool delighted fans.

articles.title: A Roman Camp Frozen in Time: Mass Graves and Preserved Sandals Unearthed in Slovakia
articles.summary: An "extremely rare" Roman marching camp from the Marcomannic Wars has been discovered in Slovakia, containing hastily buried soldiers—some in wells. The 18.2-acre site near Šurany includes fortifications and a wealth of artifacts, including intact caligae sandals. Researchers believe the camp was abandoned immediately after a conflict with Germanic tribes around A.D. 180.
